The freeze commit's '35' counted numbered slots V2-01 through V2-35 (35 numbers) without noticing that slot V2-01 (GAMEDAY) alone expands into FOUR physical canvas frames: the carousel artboard V2-01 itself (dc.html line 1126, 'GAMEDAY . NO DEMONSTRATED EDGE', 1280x1120) plus three dedicated verdict-state artboards under its own 'V2-01a . b . c . THE VERDICT FAMILY' motion-spec heading (dc.html line 2090): V2-01a NO_PLAY . 93.0%  (line 1674, 1280x820), V2-01b FLAGGED . 2.3%   (line 1881, 1280x470), V2-01c MARKET_UNAVAILABLE . 4.7% (line 1982, 1280x430). 35 numbered slots + 3 extra lettered state-variant artboards under slot 01 = 38 physical artboards. No other numbered slot (V2-02 through V2-35) carries a lettered variant. Verified by direct line count of every 'V2-NN[a-z]?' canvas tag in the .dc.html: 38 tags found, matching the canvas's own footer exactly.

contract_violations_note: Every Tier A artboard was checked against RECONCILED_CONTRACT_CURRENT_HEAD.md's 'Must NOT appear as live (D/E)' list (weather, line-movement chart/arrows, outbound sportsbook links, starter stat lines, bullpen workload, xwOBA/xFIP, win probabilities, EV, picks, confidence, ROI/records, sub-minute freshness, demo/sample chips, refund promises) and against section 4's hard prohibitions (win probability, EV/edge, picks, confidence meters, ROI/record, public-%/steam/arrows, bare rates, personalized diffs, BELOW MARKET badge, MODERATE/STRONG support language, 'UPDATED 32 SEC AGO', '7 PTS BETTER' hero, book links, fixed '11 BOOKS', team-name evidence grouping). Every hit for a prohibited term (win probability, confidence meter, ROI, MODERATE, xwOBA, xFIP, steam, BELOW MARKET, SEC AGO, OPEN AT BOOK) in the .dc.html was individually read in context: every one of them is the design system EXPLICITLY STATING the prohibition as a rule or an honesty caption (e.g. My Bets' own 'NO RECORD . NO ROI . NO UNITS . NO WIN RATE' label, the Landing page's 'what we will never do' list, the Component Kit's 'NO LIMITED / MODERATE / STRONG LADDER -- WRONG WORD SET' rule) -- none is the artboard itself rendering the prohibited thing as live data. The ONE artboard that does show rating/probability/rank-shaped numbers is V2-35, and it is correctly self-labelled 'TIER B . BLOCKED ON VALIDATION' / 'future, validation-dependent' / 'NOT YET EARNED' throughout, with an explicit in-canvas fallback rule that the ROUTE renders the Tier A Odds board instead until validation lands. No artboard was found asserting Tier-B/D/E data as though it were live. contract_violations_found is empty because none exist in the frozen design -- the risk is entirely on the IMPLEMENTATION side (a worker fast-following V2-35's visual against a real computation), which is why its manifest entry carries an explicit gate warning.

artboards.title: RANKED BOARD · TIER B
target_js_files: web/js/ranked.js (NEW, does not exist yet -- gated)

The artboard itself renders illustrative figures explicitly labelled as such: "OUR MODEL" probability (0.571), "MARKET IMPLIED" probability, "THE GAP" (+.039), a 0-100 "BET RATING" on a ring, and a "No.2 STRONGEST MLB BET TODAY" badge with a provenance strip (sample n, forward-tested window, Brier calibration, last-audited date).
fields_NOT_available: model win probability (permanently absent from every payload per API_CONTRACTS.md's vocabulary rules)
states_designed: "blocked on validation" (this IS the only state -- the artboard's own fallback rule: until Engine 2 validates, this ROUTE renders the Tier A ODDS board instead, same games, ordered by measured price gap, never this screen)
artboards.note: CONTRACT-GATED, TIER B: this is the Ranker's win-probability / rated / ranked-board concept (src/report/ranker.py, ENGINE2 = None). The system rule is absolute: the Ranker publishes no recommendations while Engine 2 is None, enforced by tests/test_ranker.py. Do NOT implement web/js/ranked.js against live data. It may be scaffolded as inert/disabled UI (nav entry hidden or disabled) but must not render a rating, probability, gap or rank from any real computation -- there is no field to bind to, and the design's own text says so ("NOT YET EARNED", "future, validation-dependent", "blocked on validation"). This is the single highest-risk artboard for a Ranker-gate violation if a worker fast-follows the visual without reading this note.
